recognize_zh: 視野中有兩顆小型淋巴球，核圓、染色質粗塊狀，其中一顆的細胞質下緣有一串清楚的小空泡；右上角另有一個被推擠拉長的破碎細胞（smudge cell），這兩個線索合起來支持帶空泡的 CLL 細胞。
features: Small mature-appearing lymphocytes with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nuclei with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin and no visible nucleoli
Scant pale blue cytoplasm; the central cell shows a cluster of several small clear vacuoles at one pole
Smudge cell with streaming nuclear material at upper right
Background normocytic red cells and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows small mature-appearing lymphocytes with round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm. One lymphocyte contains a cluster of small, discrete clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, and a smudge cell with streaming chromatin is present at the edge of the field. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with cytoplasmic vacuolation, in keeping with the stated CLL immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma cells tend to have more irregular nuclei and fewer smudge cells, and are separated definitively by cyclin D1/SOX11 expression and CD23 negativity.
Burkitt cells are larger with fine chromatin, nucleoli and intensely basophilic, heavily vacuolated cytoplasm, unlike these small clumped-chromatin cells.

ddx.dx: Vacuolated lymphocytes of lysosomal storage disease
ddx.vs: Storage disease vacuoles appear in polyclonal lymphocytes of normal count in patients with systemic features, without smudge cells or a clonal CD5+/CD23+ population.
Splenic marginal zone lymphoma cells often have polar villous projections and more cytoplasm, and are usually CD5 and CD23 negative.
